baseline.input: Fixed-pose integration from atlas-l-newest/component-000, before frame 4493 recovery

candidate_frame_2000.method: For this single pose candidate, union every retained baseline track except those failing full-observation re-triangulation, then add successful full crossing tracks. Never use partial left-plus-target tracks. Count supports across all observations, including non-target frames. No model modification.

verification.caveat: The Rust diagnostic component_count/component_sizes fields count supported frames only. This evidence explicitly distinguishes those from the all-frame graph used by the independent Python auditor.

decision: Implement a default-off transactional single-frame repair, selected by geometry, strict reduction in supported graph components and preservation of every previously supported image/frame. Explicitly account for removed tracks and observations. Combine with independent unsupported-frame recovery only in a separately validated real-model run. Do not claim COLMAP parity from this hypothetical graph.
